# nuthatch nest on mainnet

A self-hosted blockchain index. Query it locally; there is no third-party API.

## Contracts
- `c0` = 0xc3d688b66703497daa19211eedff47f25384cdc3

## Tables (one per contract event)
- `c0__absorb_collateral` - AbsorbCollateral(address,address,address,uint256,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, absorber, borrower, asset, collateralAbsorbed, usdValue)
- `c0__absorb_debt` - AbsorbDebt(address,address,uint256,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, absorber, borrower, basePaidOut, usdValue)
- `c0__buy_collateral` - BuyCollateral(address,address,uint256,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, buyer, asset, baseAmount, collateralAmount)
- `c0__pause_action` - PauseAction(bool,bool,bool,bool,bool) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, supplyPaused, transferPaused, withdrawPaused, absorbPaused, buyPaused)
- `c0__supply` - Supply(address,address,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, from, dst, amount)
- `c0__supply_collateral` - SupplyCollateral(address,address,address,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, from, dst, asset, amount)
- `c0__transfer` - Transfer(address,address,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, from, to, amount)
- `c0__transfer_collateral` - TransferCollateral(address,address,address,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, from, to, asset, amount)
- `c0__withdraw` - Withdraw(address,address,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, src, to, amount)
- `c0__withdraw_collateral` - WithdrawCollateral(address,address,address,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, src, to, asset, amount)
- `c0__withdraw_reserves` - WithdrawReserves(address,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, to, amount)

## Live HTTP API (run `nuthatch dev`)
- `GET /`                    index status
- `GET /tables`              every table with its columns
- `GET /table/{name}?limit=N` recent rows of one table (hot + sealed)
- `GET /entity/{id}`         one row by id (`{block:012}-{logindex:06}`)
- `GET /sql?q=SELECT...`     read-only SQL; each table is a view named `{alias}__{event}`
- `GET /balances?limit=N`    top holder balances (when an ERC-20 Transfer table is present)
- `GET /balance/{address}`   one address's derived balance

## MCP (for coding agents)
Run `nuthatch mcp` (stdio) to expose tools: status, schema, tables, table, sql, entity,
balance, top_balances. Fully offline against the local instance; nothing phones home.
